You can also set a crawl delay using: User-agent: ClaudeBot / Crawl-delay: 1. Note that blocking via IP addresses is not recommended as it may prevent Anthropic from reading your robots.txt file. You can verify crawler source IPs at https://claude.com/crawling/bots.json. If you have further questions or believe the crawler is malfunctioning, contact claudebot@anthropic.com from an email associated with your domain.
justification: The user wants to block Anthropic's web crawler. The response is directly grounded in the 'Does Anthropic crawl data from the web' documentation which provides exact robots.txt instructions.
